defects.correction: Bind recurrence to selected matching memory, historical to two observed occurrences, and novel to one occurrence.
Use a general evidence hierarchy for contradiction, complete proof, bounded partial proof, and insufficiency.
Map evidence state and reachability to one legal continuation without premature generic rejection or stop.
Require a selected memory recurrence signature to match the visible causal mechanism.
Require one compact current action and prohibit transcript restatement or future-action prewriting.
Keep every unresolved material contradiction visible and block proof-complete or advance claims.
Do not modify the V2 scorer. For future held-out cases provide a visible deterministic causal-label derivation independent of hidden outcomes.
